liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Race is On** (2 reviews): Reviewer wonders why it was played, guessing a link to the NYC marathon day; Reviewer finds it thrown in from nowhere and badly played [15][17]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (2 reviews): Very strong, with nice lead playing from Vince; Reviewer rates it better than many 1970s versions [14][17]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer describes the first-set version as hopping [14]
- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Flows so smoothly into Johnny B. Goode that the transition is hardly noticed [17]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry seeming lost and barely keeping the beat [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls the second-set version killer [20]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer praises the second-set version as killer [20]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Jerry again seems to struggle at points, which the reviewer links to his slide-era 1993 playing [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Race is On**: back after 178 archived shows (870 days) [22]
- **Electronic Percussion**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]
- **Space**: with Edie Brickell [22]
- **Goin' Down the Road**: with Edie Brickell [22]
- **Baba O'Riley**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]
- **Tomorrow Never Knows**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-20.schoeps.andrewf.131592.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 153 min [1]
- **gd93-09-20.ams-brennecke-young.4531.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1993-09-20.157808.neum.gen1.miller.t.flac1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 148 min [5]
- **gd93-09-20.sbd.wiley.8766.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min; rated 3.89/5 by 9 [9]. Said about its sound: Set one comes from a different source, with very muddy vocals; second set sounds better; Reviewer says the first set is smoking, and recommends seeking a better copy; they still play their analog master; Best heard through one of the high-quality soundboard versions in circulation [11][13][16]

## Around the show

- Guests: Edie Brickell [1]
- Edie Brickell sang during Space and joined the band afterward, notably for the closing Goin' Down the Road [12]
- Edie chants during Space, her voice reverbed and echoed through the monitors by the sound crew [14]
- Encore was Baba O'Riley into Tomorrow Never Knows; Space and Goin' Down the Road are marked with an asterisk [1]
- Edie Brickell sang during Space and Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad [4]
- Edie Brickell joined for Space and Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad [5]
- Reviewer calls it a gem in a year with few good shows [12]
- Reviewer sees the show as like most of 1993, with Edie as the draw [15]
- Reviewer ranks it below 1969, 1972-74 and Spring '77, but among 1993's better shows [16]
- Reviewer calls it one of the weakest 1993 shows, picking up only in Drums and Space [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-20.schoeps.andrewf.131592.flac1644**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (ORTF) > unknown mic power and lead dat deck > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 > TDK DA-R DAT, set up end of floor center, directly behind the… [1]. Also: Schoeps-based recording, FLAC 16-bit/44.1k, uploaded by Andrew F [1]
- **gd93-09-20.ams-brennecke-young.4531.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Clay Brennecke and Jamie Young; source: Audience: Schoeps S4 [4]. Also: Reviewer says the microphones listed for this audience recording are wrong; they should be Schoeps CMC5 with MK4 capsules [18]
- **gd1993-09-20.157808.neum.gen1.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Charlie Miller; transferred by Recording, Transfer and Mastering by Charlie Miller Pitch Correction by Scott Clugston  December 5, 2016 (Transfer) July 10, 2022 (Mastering); source: Neumann KMR 82i > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B) > Cassette [5]. Also: Neumann-source generation 1 transfer by Miller, found unmastered on a backup drive; masters lost, converted from 24/96 to 16/44.1 [5]
- **gd93-09-20.sbd.wiley.8766.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>?>CDR [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden - September 20, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/september-20-1993) [23]
